Lemma
[The Differential is an Isometry onto the Tangent Space]

↗ def:induced-tensor-along-map ↗ lem:pseudo-submanifold-immersion

If $g$ is induced by $\widetilde g$ along smooth $F:M\to \widetilde M$, then $dF_x$ is an isometry from $(T_xM,g_x)$ onto $dF_x(T_xM)$ with the restricted ambient form.
Proof

↗ def:induced-tensor-along-map ↗ lem:pseudo-submanifold-immersion \sketch Lemma 17 makes $dF_x$ an isomorphism onto its image, and Definition 17 says it preserves the forms.

□
